_note: SOURCES.json — one row per skill: where it really came from, what it was called upstream, where it runs, and whether we adapted it. Edit this file, then re-run bin/gen_skills_index.py. Sources: docs/reports/skills-audit-20261118.md (code lane, KEEP/KEEP+PATCH) + live description-match against the public hubs (2026-11-21).
_fields: repo = github owner/name, or 'ours' / 'minis-builtin'. upstream = the original folder name before our rename. verified = the match was proven (audit record or description match 1.00). verdict = the 2026-11-18 audit call (KEEP | KEEP+PATCH | ours). where = device | vm | both | prompt-only. adapted = we have edited the body/scripts.
